mapper.update: UPDATE stock_sync_run SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{finished}, failure_type = 'InterruptedRun' WHERE run_date < #{date} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO stock_sync_run (run_date, run_id, status, attempt_count, started_at) VALUES (#{date}, #{runId}, 'RUNNING', 0, #{started})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_sync_run SET run_id = #{runId}, status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = #{started}, finished_at = NULL, failure_type = NULL, downloaded_count = NULL, inserted_count = NULL, deactivated_count = NULL, cancelled_order_count = NULL WHERE run_date = #{date} AND status <> 'SUCCEEDED'
mapper.select: SELECT run_id FROM stock_sync_run WHERE run_date = #{date} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_sync_run SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = #{finished}, failure_type = NULL, downloaded_count = #{result.totalDownloaded}, inserted_count = #{result.insertedCount}, deactivated_count = #{result.deactivatedCount}, cancelled_order_count = #{result.cancelledOrderCount} WHERE run_date = #{date} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE stock_sync_run SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{finished}, failure_type = #{failureType} WHERE run_date = #{date} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
